LOC_RECEIPT_FAX_PURPOSE.source: 接收来电、外界消息和随信送来的物资。
LOC_RECEIPT_FAX_PURPOSE.zh_CN: 接收来电、外界消息和随信送来的物资。
LOC_RECEIPT_FAX_PURPOSE.en: Receives calls, news from outside, and supplies sent with the messages.

LOC_RECEIPT_FAX_NOTE.source: 细细的电流声。远处发生的事，抵达这里时只剩一张温热的纸。
LOC_RECEIPT_FAX_NOTE.zh_CN:
“每台电脑都该有它！”
《Zork I》传单
LOC_RECEIPT_FAX_NOTE.en:
“No computer should be without one!”
Zork I, leaflet

LOC_RECEIPT_PRINTER_PURPOSE.source: 记录你的操作、点数收支与机器日志。
LOC_RECEIPT_PRINTER_PURPOSE.zh_CN: 记录你的操作、点数收支与机器日志。
LOC_RECEIPT_PRINTER_PURPOSE.en: Records your actions, points earned and spent, and machine logs.

LOC_RECEIPT_PRINTER_NOTE.source: 纸卷又短了一截。墨迹还湿着，今天已经有了凭据。
LOC_RECEIPT_PRINTER_NOTE.en:
“A transmitter and not a maker”
The Analects, book 7

LOC_RECEIPT_MONITOR_PURPOSE.source: 追踪模因点数的收支，以及可用的意识形态和语用资源。
LOC_RECEIPT_MONITOR_PURPOSE.zh_CN: 追踪模因点数的收支，以及可用的意识形态和语用资源。
LOC_RECEIPT_MONITOR_PURPOSE.en: Tracks meme points earned and spent, along with available ideology and pragmatics resources.

LOC_RECEIPT_MONITOR_NOTE.source: 屏幕泛着绿光，数字在里面轻轻跳了一下。那一点变化，够你盯上很久。
LOC_RECEIPT_MONITOR_NOTE.zh_CN:
“丹麦国里恐怕有些不可告人的坏事。”
莎士比亚《哈姆莱特》第一幕第四场
LOC_RECEIPT_MONITOR_NOTE.en:
“Something is rotten in the state of Denmark.”
Shakespeare, Hamlet, Act I, scene iv

LOC_RECEIPT_FOLDER_PURPOSE.source: 收存语言、群体、话题和补丁卡片。
LOC_RECEIPT_FOLDER_PURPOSE.zh_CN: 收存语言、群体、话题和补丁卡片。
LOC_RECEIPT_FOLDER_PURPOSE.en: Stores language, group, topic, and patch cards.

LOC_RECEIPT_FOLDER_NOTE.source: 纸页被压得很平。那些还没用上的念头，在夹层里挨着彼此。
LOC_RECEIPT_FOLDER_NOTE.zh_CN:
“学而时习之，不亦说乎？”
《论语·学而》
LOC_RECEIPT_FOLDER_NOTE.en:
“Is it not pleasant to learn with a constant perseverance and application?”
The Analects, book 1

LOC_RECEIPT_PHONEBOOK_PURPOSE.source: 保存联络号码，记下可以接通的联系人。
LOC_RECEIPT_PHONEBOOK_PURPOSE.zh_CN: 保存联络号码，记下可以接通的联系人。
LOC_RECEIPT_PHONEBOOK_PURPOSE.en: Keeps the numbers of people you can reach.

LOC_RECEIPT_PHONEBOOK_NOTE.source: 名字排成一列，号码缩在旁边。合上本子，声音就留在薄薄的纸后。
LOC_RECEIPT_PHONEBOOK_NOTE.zh_CN:
“有朋自远方来，不亦乐乎？”
《论语·学而》
LOC_RECEIPT_PHONEBOOK_NOTE.en:
“Is it not delightful to have friends coming from distant quarters?”
The Analects, book 1

LOC_RECEIPT_CLOCK_PURPOSE.source: 观察你的时间，现在是什么季节？
LOC_RECEIPT_CLOCK_PURPOSE.zh_CN: 观察你的时间，现在是什么季节？
LOC_RECEIPT_CLOCK_PURPOSE.en: Keep an eye on your time. What season is it now?

LOC_RECEIPT_CLOCK_NOTE.zh_CN:
“不知有汉，无论魏晋。”
陶渊明《桃花源记》
LOC_RECEIPT_CLOCK_NOTE.en:
“they had never even heard of the Han, let alone its successors the Wei and the Chin.”
Tao Yuanming, Peach Blossom Spring

LOC_RECEIPT_SPEED_PURPOSE.source: 调节世界的时间流速，让这一刻停下或快些过去。
LOC_RECEIPT_SPEED_PURPOSE.zh_CN: 调节世界的时间流速，让这一刻停下或快些过去。
LOC_RECEIPT_SPEED_PURPOSE.en: Sets the pace of time, holding this moment still or letting it pass more quickly.

LOC_RECEIPT_SPEED_NOTE.source: 几枚按键安静地并排躺着。窗外的日子正等你发话。
LOC_RECEIPT_SPEED_NOTE.zh_CN:
“逝者如斯夫！不舍昼夜。”
《论语·子罕》
LOC_RECEIPT_SPEED_NOTE.en:
“It passes on just like this, not ceasing day or night!”
The Analects, book 9

LOC_RECEIPT_MAP_PURPOSE.source: 查看各地的受众、语言与文化偏好，为模因寻找投放地点。
LOC_RECEIPT_MAP_PURPOSE.zh_CN: 查看各地的受众、语言与文化偏好，为模因寻找投放地点。
LOC_RECEIPT_MAP_PURPOSE.en: Shows local audiences, languages, and cultural preferences so you can choose where to release a meme.

LOC_RECEIPT_MAP_NOTE.source: 国境是一道细线。越过它，同一句话就有了另一种回声。
LOC_RECEIPT_MAP_NOTE.zh_CN:
“不出户，知天下。”
《道德经》第四十七章
LOC_RECEIPT_MAP_NOTE.en:
“Without going outside his door, one understands (all that takes place) under the sky”
Tao Te Ching, chapter 47

LOC_RECEIPT_EDIT_PURPOSE.source: 查看基模、装配表达补丁，辨认成品的说法和含义。
LOC_RECEIPT_EDIT_PURPOSE.zh_CN: 查看基模、装配表达补丁，辨认成品的说法和含义。
LOC_RECEIPT_EDIT_PURPOSE.en: Shows the base meme, fits expression patches, and reveals what the finished version says and means.

LOC_RECEIPT_EDIT_NOTE.source: 铅笔还搁在纸边。有几个词刚刚换过位置，整句话已经不太像昨天。
LOC_RECEIPT_EDIT_NOTE.zh_CN:
“那些看似疯狂、满脑子想要改变世界的人，真的能改变世界。”
Apple《50 Years of Thinking Different》公开信
LOC_RECEIPT_EDIT_NOTE.en:
“the people crazy enough to think they can change the world are the ones who do.”
Apple, 50 Years of Thinking Different (letter)

LOC_RECEIPT_CULTIVATE_PURPOSE.source: 组合语言、群体和话题，调整模因的立场与语气。
LOC_RECEIPT_CULTIVATE_PURPOSE.zh_CN: 组合语言、群体和话题，调整模因的立场与语气。
LOC_RECEIPT_CULTIVATE_PURPOSE.en: Combines languages, groups, and topics, and shapes the meme's stance and tone.

LOC_RECEIPT_CULTIVATE_NOTE.source: 一张空椅子，一句没说完的话。先有人坐下来，意思才慢慢长出来。
LOC_RECEIPT_CULTIVATE_NOTE.zh_CN:
“道生一，一生二，二生三，三生万物。”
《道德经》第四十二章
LOC_RECEIPT_CULTIVATE_NOTE.en:
“The Tao produced One; One produced Two; Two produced Three; Three produced All things.”
Tao Te Ching, chapter 42

LOC_RECEIPT_SPREAD_PURPOSE.source: 解锁传播能力，让模因更容易被接触、转述和再创作。
LOC_RECEIPT_SPREAD_PURPOSE.zh_CN: 解锁传播能力，让模因更容易被接触、转述和再创作。
LOC_RECEIPT_SPREAD_PURPOSE.en: Unlocks abilities that help people encounter, repeat, and remix your meme.

LOC_RECEIPT_SPREAD_NOTE.source: 隔壁的声音已经传到街角。你的话还在门口，等一阵顺路的风。
LOC_RECEIPT_SPREAD_NOTE.en:
“Virtue is not left to stand alone. He who practises it will have neighbors.”
The Analects, book 4
